# Cytoscape Web App Cookbook

Task-oriented recipes for Cytoscape Web apps. Each recipe is one file:
a function of `apis` that performs one task, with a header that says when
to use it, what it changes, and what not to do.

- **Using a recipe:** [USING-RECIPES.md](USING-RECIPES.md)
- **Writing one:** [WRITING-RECIPES.md](WRITING-RECIPES.md)
- **What these were verified with:** [verified.json](verified.json), and
  [runner/README.md](runner/README.md) for how

25 recipes. Find one by the words in "Also asked as".

## network

| Recipe | Also asked as | Calls |

## Wiring

Every recipe takes `apis`. These files show where `apis` comes from at
each call site.

- [wiring/from-apps-menu.ts](wiring/from-apps-menu.ts) — Call site 2 of 4: the `onClick` of an `'apps-menu'` entry.
- [wiring/from-mount.ts](wiring/from-mount.ts) — Call site 1 of 4: `mount(context)` and `unmount()`.
- [wiring/from-panel.tsx](wiring/from-panel.tsx) — Call site 3 of 4: a React component, such as a `'right-panel'` panel.
- [wiring/from-window.ts](wiring/from-window.ts) — Call site 4 of 4: `window.CyWebApi`, from code that is not an app.
